name: Hanatsubaki Goro
source:
A world-renowned fashion designer who holds numerous titles, such as the apparel world's chief arbiter and a true fashion leader. He is also a close friend of Amanohashi, and often visits Habataki Academy in search of inspiration. His personality, way of speaking, and poses are all quite eccentric.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
